text:
lex: Heads up — proposing a temporary 'twilight' pin on runtime v3.2.1 for the EU canary window. Small subset (5%) of traffic for quantized models has been hitting long-sequence OOMs in canary runs. Need quick decision.

sam: What is the concrete blast radius? SLAs impacted? How long are you proposing to keep the pin?

lex: Hosted public endpoints largely unaffected; this is scoped to eu-canary and the dedicated quantized inference pool (llama3-q, quant-v3b mapping). Expected throughput drop ~3% for that cohort. Plan: pin for up to 4h while we run expanded longseq tests and validate fixes.

deploy-bot: Pin request created: `/pin add runtime:v3.2.1 --scope=eu-canary --expires=4h --reason="longseq OOMs quant"` (PinID: pin-20240325-11). Action: applied to canary routing by orchestrator.

anya: +1 for temporary pin. Can QA run the full longseq regression suite asap? @taylor can you pick this up?

taylor: Scheduling now, starting tests in ~15m. Will stream logs to #eng-runtime-telemetry. Smoke command I'm running: ```scripts/smoke_longseq.sh --model llama3-q --iters 100 --trace mem```.

sam: Draft release note blurb: "Temporary twilight pin of runtime v3.2.1 on EU canary to mitigate long-sequence OOMs for quantized models. Expected to be removed after validation; no action required for most customers." Thoughts?

lex: Rollback/abort criteria I propose: - error rate > 1% sustained for 10m OR - latency p95 increase > 200ms vs baseline. Rollback steps: `/pin remove pin-20240325-11` OR `deploybot rollback --pin pin-20240325-11`. If we rollback, escalate to #incidents and page SRE.

deploy-bot: Pin applied to 12 eu-canary hosts. Monitoring alert created: `canary-pin-1716459876` (thresholds set per lex's criteria).

anya: QA started. First batch: 30/30 longseq runs passed w/o OOMs. Continuing a broader sweep now. :thumbsup:

taylor: Telemetry shows small mem tail spikes on 2 hosts but under warning threshold. I'll keep the run going and post a summary after the 100 iters.

lex: Thanks. I'm adding a short note to the release notes and will loop back once QA finishes. Target: remove pin at +4h if green. If anyone needs to extend, reply here with reason and duration. Tagging @sam @anya for signoff before removal.

sam: Signoff pending final QA summary. If QA stays green, approve removal at T+4h.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled at T+3h30m to re-evaluate — command: `/pin check pin-20240325-11 --telemetry canary-pin-1716459876`.
